timeline.title: Foundation of India Post
timeline.description: India Post was established under a modern postal system, laying the foundation for organized communication across India.

timeline.title: World's First Airmail
timeline.description: India Post handled the first official airmail flight from Allahabad to Naini.

timeline.title: PIN Code Introduced
timeline.description: Postal Index Number system improved sorting and delivery efficiency.

timeline.title: Speed Post Launch
timeline.description: Fast and reliable express delivery service introduced across India.

timeline.title: India Post Payments Bank
timeline.description: Banking services expanded with IPPB to enhance financial inclusion.

services.title: Mail Services
services.description: India Post delivers letters, postcards, inland mail, registered documents, and official communication across India.

services.title: Speed Post
services.description: Speed Post ensures time-bound delivery with tracking and nationwide reach.

services.title: Parcel Services
services.description: Supports e-commerce logistics and secure parcel transportation across India and abroad.

services.title: Financial Services
services.description: Provides savings accounts and government-backed schemes for secure financial planning.

services.title: Postal Life Insurance
services.description: PLI and RPLI offer trusted and government-backed life insurance services.

services.title: India Post Payments Bank
services.description: Offers digital banking, money transfers, bill payments, and rural financial inclusion.

schemes.name: Savings Account
schemes.description: A secure and simple savings account for everyday banking needs.

schemes.name: Recurring Deposit
schemes.description: A disciplined monthly savings scheme for long-term growth.

schemes.name: Time Deposit
schemes.description: Fixed investment scheme offering safe and predictable returns.

schemes.name: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
schemes.description: Long-term savings scheme with tax benefits and compounded growth.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi
schemes.description: Savings scheme for securing the future of a girl child.

jobs.title: Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS)
jobs.description: Entry-level rural role handling mail delivery and postal services in villages.

jobs.title: Multi Tasking Staff (MTS)
jobs.description: Handles office maintenance, file management, and operational support.

jobs.title: Postman / Mail Guard
jobs.description: Responsible for delivering mail and managing postal movement.

jobs.title: Postal Assistant
jobs.description: Handles customer services, savings accounts, and counter operations.

jobs.title: Sorting Assistant
jobs.description: Manages sorting and dispatch of letters and parcels.

jobs.title: Inspector Posts
jobs.description: Ensures service quality and monitors post office operations.

jobs.title: Assistant Superintendent (ASP)
jobs.description: Supervises staff and supports postal administration.

jobs.title: Superintendent of Post Offices
jobs.description: Manages postal divisions and operational performance.

jobs.title: Postmaster General (PMG)
jobs.description: Oversees regional postal operations within a circle.

jobs.title: Director General
jobs.description: Highest authority responsible for national postal administration.

modern.title: Digital Postal Services
modern.description: Provides tracking, updates, and digital access to postal services.

modern.title: India Post Payments Bank
modern.description: Offers financial services including transfers, payments, and banking access.

modern.title: E-Commerce Logistics
modern.description: Supports online businesses with efficient logistics and delivery.

modern.title: Core Banking
modern.description: Enables digital transactions and improved banking convenience.

modern.title: Doorstep Services
modern.description: Provides Aadhaar, banking, and public services directly to customers.

modern.title: Technology Operations
modern.description: Improves efficiency using automation, tracking, and modern systems.
